title: Presentation of the TRC Final Report to President Mandela
summary: On 29 October 1998 Archbishop Desmond Tutu presented the five-volume report of South Africa's Truth and Reconciliation Commission to President Nelson Mandela. It drew on about 21,000 statements and set out the commission's findings on gross human rights violations under apartheid. An ANC court challenge to publication came on the eve of release.
